objects.description: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) leveraged Sysmon to understand the processes, services in the organization.(Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018) [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has used Python versions of its remote access tools on Linux targets.(Citation: Microsoft Axios Compromise APR 2026) [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has also configured malicious payloads to gather running processes using `ps aux`.(Citation: Microsoft Sapphire Sleet APR 2026)(Citation: MIcrosoft Mastra npm Compromise JUN 2026)
